fields.Name: AQLLevel
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Default AQL level for a sampling plan.  Describes the number of Rejects allowed for a specific AQL level for a given Sample Size.  Each instance of this object represents an Acceptable Quality Level (AQL) value that is assigned to a Sample Plan (i.e. 0.25, 1.5, 4.0, etc.).

fields.Name: InspectionLevel
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: The default Inspection Level for a sampling plan. Each instance of this object maintains a set of quantity ranges and their associated Lot Size Code to be assigned to a Sample Plan.

fields.Name: MoveContainerOnCompletion
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Flag to determine whether to move the container when sampling is completed and passed

fields.Name: Resource
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Sets the Default Resource for the Sampling Plan.  If one is not defined in the SamplingPlan Details this will be the default.

fields.Name: SampleRate
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: The default sampling rate for a sampling plan defined for every nth container.  ex. If rate =1 then every container is sampled.  If rate is 3 then ever 3rd container is sampled.

fields.Name: SampleRateMaxDuration
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Maximum number of days since Product was last run before resetting the  counters for Rate

fields.Name: SampleSizeBasedOnStartQty
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Determines if the Sample Size should be based on the Start Quantity or Current Container Qty

fields.Name: Spec
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Default Spec for all Sample Test in the sampling plan.

fields.Name: SwitchingRule
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Defines the default Switching Rules for an AQL Sampling plan.  Defines the rule for switching between inspection levels.

fields.Name: SwitchingRuleMaxDuration
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Maximum number of days since Product was last run before resetting the consecutive passes counter in the SamplingCurrentStatus

fields.Name: Vendor
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: The default Vendor for theSampling Plan if one is not defined on the sampling plan details.

fields.Name: VendorItem
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Vendor Items are the products the vendor sells.  This item is specified in the Product where, for purchased products, one can relate the product to a list of sources where the product can be purchased.  In addition, when issuing components to a container, one can specify the VendorItem used to fulfill the component requirement.

fields.Name: SamplingPlanDetails
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: The specific describes the details for a Sampling Plan's Sample Test..  For each  Sample Test, the AQL Level, Inspection Level, Switching Rule, Spec, Vendor and Resoruce can be configured.

fields.Name: AQLLevel
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: The AQL for the Sample Test.  Describes the number of Rejects allowed for a specific AQL level for a given Sample Size.  Each instance of this object represents an Acceptable Quality Level (AQL) value that is assigned to a Sample Plan (i.e. 0.25, 1.5, 4.0, etc.).

fields.Name: ExportImportKey
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Hexadecimal representation of GUID ( e.g. BDE4B634-153E-4A31-A453-EEA85FE80532)

fields.Name: InspectAll
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Boolean Flag indicatin sample size = container.qty

fields.Name: InspectAllContQty
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Indicates that inspection of all the containers' quantity is required for this product

fields.Name: InspectAllQtyOnFailure
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Indicates that the quantity of all container will be inspected if a test fails

fields.Name: InspectionLevel
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: default Inspection Level for this Sample Test.  Each instance of this object maintains a set of quantity ranges and their associated Lot Size Code to be assigned to a Sample Plan.

fields.Name: IsFrozen
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Determines if changes are allowed to this instance (or any of its revisions)

fields.Name: Resource
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Identifies the Resource for the Sampling Plan’s sample test.

fields.Name: SampleRate
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: This value set the sampling rate. Sampling Rate is counted for every nth container.  For example if sampling rate is 1 every container is sampled.  If Sample rate is 2 every other container is sampled.

fields.Name: SampleTest
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: The SampleTest to be executed in the sampling plan.

fields.Name: Sequence
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Sequence of the Sampling Plan Details List

fields.Name: Spec
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Identifies the Spec for the Sampling Plan’s sample test.  This field is required.

fields.Name: SwitchingRule
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Object used to define the Switching Rules for a specific Sample Test within a Sampling Plan.  Defines the rule for switching between inspection levels.

fields.Name: Vendor
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Identifies the Vendor for the Sampling Plan’s sample test.

fields.Name: VendorItem
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Vendor Items are the products the vendor sells.  This item is specified in the Product where, for purchased products, one can relate the product to a list of sources where the product can be purchased.  In addition, when issuing components to a container, one can specify the VendorItem used to fulfill the component requirement.

fields.Name: AllowMoveOnFailure
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Indicates if the container can be moved if a sample test is rejected.

fields.Name: AQLRejectReasons
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Provides a list of reject reasons for sample failures.  This is used for counted sample types only.  The user will be displayed a list of reasons and they can enter the number of samples that failed for each reason.

fields.Name: Classification
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Used to classify QualityObjects.  This is the default classification used for creating a Production even upon the failure of the Sample Test.

fields.Name: DecreaseByRejectCountReason
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations:
Indicates the container’s qty will be reduced by the
Reject Count using the selected Loss Reason Code.

fields.Name: DecreaseBySampleSizeReason
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Indicates the Container’s quantity will be reduced by the Sample Size using the selected Loss Reason Code.  Can be used to reduce the containers qty for destructive testing.

fields.Name: DefaultFailureMode
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations:
Indicates the container’s qty will be reduced by the
Reject Count using the selected Loss Reason Code.

fields.Name: DefaultPEDescription
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Description of the Production Event that will be created dynamically for this sample test.

fields.Name: Instructions
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Intructions for the user when performing the Sample Test

fields.Name: SampleDataPoints
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations:
A List of the data points to be collected for this sample test.  Used to group multiple data points into one sample test.  This is used only for measured and external sampling.  
For Measured Sampling, if one or multiple datapoints fail for the sample test the reject count is incremented by 1 for the container. 
For External Sampling, only one Sample Data Point is required, and its Lower and Upper Limit has to be 1 to accurately record Sample Result. 
0 = Fail, 1 = Pass.

fields.Name: SampleType
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations:
Used to identify the Sample Test type associated with a Product Sampling Plan.
Counted= 1
Measured = 2
External = 3

fields.Name: ScrapCountedRejectsByReason
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Scrap Counted Rejects By Reason

fields.Name: SubClassification
fields.{customAttribute}Annotations: Used to subclassify QualityObjects.  Default subclassification used to create a production event dynamically when a sample test fails.

deferred_service.name: CurrentSamplingStatusUpdate
deferred_service.scope: container-based products; next eligible container only; not in-progress containers or lot sampling
